properties.name: ckc.enabled
properties.description: Enables CKC Spring Boot auto-configuration.

properties.name: ckc.lifecycle.phase
properties.description: Spring SmartLifecycle phase used by starter-managed CKC consumers.

properties.name: ckc.lifecycle.shutdown-timeout
properties.description: Maximum time the starter waits for CKC consumers to stop gracefully.

properties.name: ckc.health.enabled
properties.description: Enables CKC Spring Boot Actuator health indicator when Actuator is on the classpath.

properties.name: ckc.observability.mdc.enabled
properties.description: Enables coroutine-safe MDC context around starter-managed record processing callbacks.

properties.name: ckc.observability.mdc.include-key
properties.description: Adds the Kafka record key to MDC as kafka.key. Disabled by default to avoid key string conversion and high-cardinality log context.

properties.name: ckc.observability.mdc.max-key-length
properties.description: Maximum kafka.key MDC value length when key inclusion is enabled.

properties.name: ckc.default-cluster
properties.description: Default cluster name used by consumers that do not set ckc.consumers.<name>.cluster.

properties.name: ckc.default-retry-schema
properties.description: Default retry schema name used by consumers that do not set ckc.consumers.<name>.retry-schema.

properties.name: ckc.default-processing-dispatcher
properties.description: Default processing dispatcher name used by consumers that do not set ckc.consumers.<name>.processing-dispatcher.

properties.name: ckc.dispatchers.*.type
properties.description: Processing dispatcher implementation.

properties.name: ckc.dispatchers.*.threads
properties.description: Fixed thread pool size for FIXED_THREAD_POOL dispatchers.

properties.name: ckc.dispatchers.*.thread-name-prefix
properties.description: Thread name prefix used by starter-created fixed-thread or virtual-thread dispatchers.

properties.name: ckc.dispatchers.*.bean-name
properties.description: Spring bean name for BEAN dispatchers. The bean must be a CoroutineDispatcher.

properties.name: ckc.metrics.enabled
properties.description: Enables CKC consumer metrics wiring.

properties.name: ckc.metrics.implementation
properties.description: Metrics implementation used for starter-managed consumers.

properties.name: ckc.metrics.prefix
properties.description: Micrometer metric prefix used when no Micrometer schemas are configured.

properties.name: ckc.metrics.micrometer.default-schema
properties.description: Default Micrometer schema name used when a consumer does not set ckc.consumers.<name>.metrics.schema.

properties.name: ckc.metrics.micrometer.schemas.*.metric-prefix
properties.description: Metric prefix prepended to CKC Micrometer meter names.

properties.name: ckc.metrics.micrometer.schemas.*.static-tags
properties.description: Static Micrometer tags attached to every meter created from this schema.

properties.name: ckc.metrics.micrometer.schemas.*.static-tags[].name
properties.description: Static Micrometer tag name.

properties.name: ckc.metrics.micrometer.schemas.*.static-tags[].value
properties.description: Static Micrometer tag value.

properties.name: ckc.metrics.micrometer.schemas.*.record-driven-tags
properties.description: Record-driven Micrometer tag schema entries.

properties.name: ckc.metrics.micrometer.schemas.*.record-driven-tags[].name
properties.description: Record-driven Micrometer tag name.

properties.name: ckc.metrics.micrometer.schemas.*.record-driven-tags[].default
properties.description: Default tag value used when no extractor is available or an extractor returns null.

properties.name: ckc.retry-schemas.*.rules
properties.description: Ordered retry rules. The first rule matching a thrown exception is used.

properties.name: ckc.retry-schemas.*.rules[].exceptions
properties.description: Fully qualified Throwable class names matched by this retry rule.

properties.name: ckc.retry-schemas.*.rules[].max-retries
properties.description: Maximum retry attempts after the initial processing failure.

properties.name: ckc.retry-schemas.*.rules[].delay
properties.description: Delay between retry attempts.

properties.name: ckc.clusters.*.kafka-properties
properties.description: Base Kafka consumer properties shared by consumers that reference this cluster.

properties.name: ckc.consumers.*.auto-startup
properties.description: Whether this consumer starts automatically with the Spring lifecycle.

properties.name: ckc.consumers.*.cluster
properties.description: Cluster name used by this consumer.

properties.name: ckc.consumers.*.topics
properties.description: Explicit topic list. Exactly one of topics or topic-pattern must be set.

properties.name: ckc.consumers.*.topic-pattern
properties.description: Topic subscription regex. Exactly one of topics or topic-pattern must be set.

properties.name: ckc.consumers.*.group-id
properties.description: Kafka group.id convenience property applied after raw Kafka properties.

properties.name: ckc.consumers.*.client-id
properties.description: Kafka client.id convenience property applied after raw Kafka properties.

properties.name: ckc.consumers.*.key-deserializer
properties.description: Kafka key.deserializer convenience property applied after raw Kafka properties.

properties.name: ckc.consumers.*.value-deserializer
properties.description: Kafka value.deserializer convenience property applied after raw Kafka properties.

properties.name: ckc.consumers.*.processing-mode
properties.description: CKC record processing mode.

properties.name: ckc.consumers.*.worker-concurrency
properties.description: Number of worker coroutines used for record processing.

properties.name: ckc.consumers.*.consumer-poll-loop-concurrency
properties.description: Number of Kafka poll loops created for this consumer.

properties.name: ckc.consumers.*.commit-interval
properties.description: Maximum interval between offset commit attempts in tracked at-least-once modes.

properties.name: ckc.consumers.*.commit-records-threshold
properties.description: Pending contiguous offset count per poll loop that triggers a commit before the time interval is reached.

properties.name: ckc.consumers.*.work-channel-capacity
properties.description: Bounded work-channel capacity used by the selected processing runtime.

properties.name: ckc.consumers.*.freshness-max-record-age
properties.description: Maximum Kafka record age accepted by freshness-first processing modes before the record is dropped instead of handled.

properties.name: ckc.consumers.*.processing-dispatcher
properties.description: Processing dispatcher name used for this consumer's record handler workers.

properties.name: ckc.consumers.*.metrics.schema
properties.description: Micrometer schema name used by this consumer when metrics implementation is MICROMETER.

properties.name: ckc.consumers.*.retry-schema
properties.description: Retry schema name used by this consumer.

properties.name: ckc.consumers.*.kafka-properties
properties.description: Per-consumer raw Kafka properties overriding cluster Kafka properties.

values.description: Create Micrometer-backed CKC consumer metrics from configured schemas.
Resolve custom ConsumerMetrics beans from the Spring context.
Create a starter-owned fixed thread pool dispatcher.
Resolve a CoroutineDispatcher bean by name.
